stances_toward.note: The Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao, created under the Bangsamoro Organic Law (RA 11054) after the 2014 peace agreement with the MILF. Its first parliamentary election, postponed four times, was held on 14 Sep 2026 and ended in a hung 80-seat parliament (the Bangsamoro Federalist Party and the MILF-led UBJP both short of 41; the first session is due on 30 Oct 2026). Own territory, controlled and claimed; trend warming because a decades-old war has ended in an election, not because the result is stable. Bond - grievance: the Moro conflict and the long failure of earlier settlements.

relations_to.summary: Bangsamoro Organic Law (Republic Act 11054, 2018), following the 2014 peace agreement with the MILF, set up the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao; its first parliamentary election on 14 Sep 2026 gave a hung 80-seat parliament (Bangsamoro Federalist Party 32 votes against 26 for the MILF-led UBJP) and the first session is set for 30 Oct 2026.
